quarterly_review_author_ref.quote: - Review theses at least quarterly, even when nothing dramatic has happened

project_application: Monitor the precise remaining public comparison definitions of two named issuers. Retain already answered public facts and source/time/series differences before contemplating another IR question. No financial thesis is created.
JIRA_boundary: 2018 company-side desirable disclosure/dialogue practice, not current legal determination, investor obligation, reply/publicity guarantee or trading rule.
DD_boundary: Known concerns, neutral definitions and comparisons adapted from PE meeting preparation. No PE execution, private-data request, author stock recommendation or implicit formula.
meaning_of_resolution: Resolving a comparison definition establishes only the identified comparison scope, not support for an issuer future earnings forecast or investment thesis.
